name: Cheeno
feeding: After morning walk, 120g kibble or 250g meat
After afternoon walk, between 17~18h, 120g kibble or 250g meat
treats: Dry cow ears, that she can get after her evening meal to chew on.
behavior: She can get pretty wild, so it's important to play with structure
doesn't like to be disturbed when she sleep
can resource guarding the couch, if you don't set up rules before
If she gets scared she likes to get in a safe space, like in a building entrance or something like this
training: She can only jump up on the couch when you say it's ok and you can train her by inviting her and then saying down and throw a treat on the floor

She is not allowed to be around waiting when you're eating (no laying down under the table). Her behavior is kind of tense when something eatable falls down and she is super fast. You can basically say no, and tell her to go to bed if she's placing her self under the table when you are eating.
commands: Seite (stand close to your left leg)
